notes.title: v0.0.2d - beta #4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added lighting engine to improve the overall experience
[*] Added global darkness during night
[*] Added luciferin and luciferase for bioluminescence purposes
[*] Added primitive biolamp to produce light by burning items
[*] Added biolamp to produce light with energy
[*] Added hide buildings button in toolbar
[*] You can now build on depleted resource heaps
[*] You can now build on destroyed colony chunks
[*] Resource heaps are now correctly removed when depleted
[*] Catalyzer now drops its enzyme when destroyed
[*] Transporters now drops their spec item when destroyed
[*] Now chunk health is correctly saved between sessions
[*] Item balancer can now switch between strict and overflow mode
[*] Added keybinds to next/prev item in tool palette (default to home/end)
[*] Fixed reactions zone filter which wasn’t working as intended
[*] Fixed workbench which allowed locked materials to be retrieved
[*] Fixed transparency near mouse which had buggy behavior around buildings
[*] Fixed item tunnels which could be placed on non existing tiles
[*] Bacteria can’t be hurt more than their life anymore
[*] Hide walls is now preserved between game sessions
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.2c3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now item kickers are correctly gave back when removing microtubules
[*] Fixed tubulin blue color that was incorrectly yellow
[*] Added workbench status in information tooltip
[*] Now evolution status is kept when switching from one to another
[*] Now building tasks are automatically canceled on necrotic chunks
[*] Now you can’t start new tasks on necrotic chunks
[*] Fixed issue with item tunnel craft ad negative microtubule stock
[*] Fixed rendering of sprites near the edge of the screen
[*] Fixed world fog which wasn’t rendering correctly
[*] Fixed broken world fog at load
[*] Fixed issues with tooltips when scrolling journey/evolution view
[*] Fixed information tooltip with mouse outside gameplay window
[*] Fixed crashes at runtime or while saving with a bacterial chunk attacked
[*] Increased X bounding box on game windows
[*] Added page down/up keybinds to switch tools
[*] ALT modifier now allows to pickup microtubules/kickers
[/list]
